description: This nested anchored fixture bounds observation sharing under strict alignment (engine §4.1).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%rule text $c:candidate %conditions $c.without-elision.matches(rival)
%rule candidate c B
%rule c X c [+T] | X Z [+T]
%rule rival r B
%rule r X r [+T] | X s [+T] | X Z [+T]
%rule s X r [+T] | X s [+T] | X Z [+T]
%rule fam r
